name: EA Funds (AWF / LTFF / EAIF / GHD)
notes: 1,699 grants incl. 399 from the Animal Welfare Fund. 2019-2020 are incomplete; 2025 AWF total ($4.47M) is below AWF's self-reported >$6M.

name: Manifund
notes: 1,806 projects. Tracked: animal-welfare, falcon-fund, digital-minds and the AI causes tais, ai-gov, ais-fieldbuilding, ais-advocacy, grantmaking-ai, ai-worldviews; projects under the broad gcr cause only when they are about AI, and a few animal projects filed under other causes such as ACX Grants. Amounts only (no grant date or donor); project created_at is used as the date. The Falcon Fund project is an intermediary (flagged is_regrant).

name: Survival and Flourishing Fund
notes: All rounds 2019-2026 collected (2020-2023 are half-yearly h1/h2). Older rounds use an HTML table with varying columns; newer use a div grid. 2026 main round ~$63M, mostly AI safety. Animal welfare theme round ($2-4M) not yet published. Non-animal grants bucketed as ai_safety.

name: ACE Movement Grants
notes: All historical rounds; each round is a grantee/amount table. All animal welfare.

name: Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy) - Farm Animal Welfare
notes: LARGEST SOURCE. All 635 FAW grants (2016-2026) collected by reading the paginated table in a real browser; saved to data/raw/cg/faw.tsv. Site returns 403 to scripts, so refresh is manual (re-read in a browser or request a CSV from CG). Regrants to intermediaries (Navigation Fund, Spring Innovation Fund, Founders Pledge, explicit regranting funds) are flagged is_regrant.

name: Open Wing Alliance Grants 2026
notes: All 28 grantees, $1,939,636 across 24 countries (mostly cage-free). Parsed from the table in the forum post.

name: The Navigation Fund
notes: No public grant list; states >$60M/year across all areas. Receives regrants from CG.

name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (990 filings)
notes: Checked: the Nonprofit Explorer API returns financial summaries and PDF links, not the filing XML, so grant-level Schedule I data would have to come from the IRS e-file bulk data instead. Not built.

name: vipulnaik/donations (GitHub)
notes: Checked: 211,118 rows, but none dated 2023 or later; the funders we care about stop at 2018-2019 (Open Philanthropy 2019-04, Animal Welfare Fund 2019-03, Long-Term Future Fund 2018-11, FLI 2018-09). Mostly large general foundations. Only useful for pre-2019 history.

name: ACE Recommended Charity Fund
notes: Six twice-yearly rounds, Jan 2024 to Aug 2026: 64 grants, $7.8M to ACE's recommended charities. Dated by disbursement month (a Jul-Dec 2025 round paid in Feb 2026 is Feb 2026). Rounds before 2024 are prose, not tables, and are not parsed. The Aug 2026 heading says $1.29M but its own table totals $1.37M; the table is used.

name: Strategic Animal Funding Circle (Senterra)
notes: Rounds 1-2 (2025): about $900k to 16 organisations. The post names the organisations but not each amount, so it cannot enter the grant table.

name: Good Ventures grants database
notes: The old database address now redirects to the new Our Giving page with no list or CSV. Archived pages cover only to about 2021, and its animal grants largely duplicate Coefficient Giving's list (e.g. Wild Animal Initiative $3.5M, Jun 2021), so it is not used.

name: Founders Pledge grantee pages
notes: Lists organisations funded by its community, with no grant amounts or dates.

name: Good Food Institute research grants
notes: About 140 funded research projects by title, with no amount or year per grant.

name: FarmKind
notes: Publishes how donations are split but no per-charity amounts.

name: Coefficient Giving - Navigating Transformative AI
notes: All 640 grants, 2015-2026, $1.08B in total (about $324M in 2025 and $241M in 2026 so far), read by hand from the paginated table in a real browser into data/raw/cg/tai.tsv. One row that CG lists on both of its fund pages is kept only under the farm animal fund. Three grants that pass money on to another body (FAR AI regranting, an NSF programme, a Longview RFP) are flagged as regrants.

name: Future of Life Institute grant programmes
notes: Eleven programmes with per-grant amounts, 2015-2026, 131 grants, $47.3M; every programme's count matches its page. Years for programmes whose pages carry none come from FLI's announcements. Nuclear-war research and the AI-for-SDGs call are not AI safety and are left out.

name: UK AISI Alignment Project
notes: Over GBP 27M to over 60 projects in round one (2026); no per-project list or amounts.

name: UK AISI Systemic Safety Grants
notes: 20 seed grants of up to GBP 200k; only a few awardees named, no per-project amounts.

name: Schmidt Sciences AI Safety Science
notes: 48 funded projects listed by title across two tracks; no institutions or amounts.

name: AI Safety Fund (Frontier Model Forum)
notes: Two rounds (Nov 2024, Dec 2025); no grantee list with amounts on its own site.

name: Coefficient Giving - Global Catastrophic Risks Opportunities
notes: All 300 grants, 2015-2026, $583M, read by hand into data/raw/cg/gcr.tsv. The fund mixes AI safety field-building, EA community building, biosecurity and climate engineering, so a grant is filed under AI safety only if its grantee or title mentions AI or the grantee is on an explicit list in build_grants.py (CG_GCR_AI_ORGS); the rest is other. Five EA Funds regranting grants ($24.3M) are flagged as regrants.

name: SFF Initiative Committee
notes: Gifts and grants made outside the main S-process rounds, mostly Jaan Tallinn's: 28 rows, $16.6M, all 2024. The page warns that recommendations after its final date may not be listed yet.

name: NSF Safe Learning-Enabled Systems awards
notes: 34 awards titled SLES, 2023-2025, $22.6M obligated, from the public NSF Awards API. The programme is co-funded by Coefficient Giving; CG's transfer to NSF is flagged as a regrant on the CG side so the money is counted once, here. The fetcher keeps organisation-level fields only (the API can return researchers' emails and phone numbers).

name: Trace (trace.manifund.org)
notes: A secondary aggregator ($13.7B across 3,519 records). Not used as rows: records are summed by year with no per-grant title or source link, and large parts go to 'Unknown Recipients'. Used only as a coverage check: it shows funders with no grant list here (Longview about $420M, Macroscopic about $130M, Schmidt Sciences about $88M) and higher Coefficient Giving AI totals than our collection.
